decisions.statement: The craft type catalog and the research line catalog arrive as arguments.
A research line hangs beneath the craft type the parent names.
A craft type is ordered by the game number.
A research line is ordered by the display order.
A trait is matched to the game's record by the trait's name in lower case.
A character the store has not read is left out of the answer.
Nothing here answers whether a character has finished researching.

definition: the item traits each character has researched, counted by research line and by craft
